Stay up to date?

Get a "What's New" notice when a new Dawarich version ships, including security fixes. The notice loads a small widget from my.chibichange.com. Like any web request, that host sees your IP address, browser, and the page URL, plus your Dawarich version — never your account, email, or location. You can change this anytime.

Welcome to Dawarich!

Your map starts with your next step — literally.

Invite your family

Add your family and see each other on the map.

Import your data

Supported formats

  • Google Maps: Records.json, Semantic History, Phone Takeout (.json)
  • GPX: Track files (.gpx)
  • GeoJSON: Feature collections (.json)
  • OwnTracks: Recorder files (.rec)
  • KML: KML files (.kml, .kmz)
File format is automatically detected during upload.
